headline: Ravi Teja Chilakala moves into ARC-2 gold at 13th

sections.text: Ravi Teja Chilakala gained 13.47 to reach 69.44, moving from 29th to 13th and into the 16 provisional gold places.
The gold line rose 2.22 in the past day to 68.75. Sakayori Lab is first outside gold, 17th at 68.06, 0.69 short.

sources.title: ARC-AGI-2 public leaderboard: saved board and the past day's changes
